_comment: AWS KMS twin card (Week 9, Deliverable 1). The primary path stores at-rest master keys in Azure Key Vault; this card is the documented AWS equivalent so the audit story is complete even with no AWS account. No credentials, no ARNs that grant anything - references only.
service: AWS KMS (twin of Azure Key Vault keys)

keys.purpose: Envelope-encryption master key for triage message stores and audit logs
HMAC key namespace for hashed identifiers in redacted audit logs

envelope_pattern: data key generated per batch -> encrypted under the KMS key -> wrapped key + ciphertext stored together (see encrypt_at_rest.py for the local teaching implementation)
who_to_ask: platform-security owns both aliases; rotation tickets are tracked in the same queue as the Key Vault rotation
teaching_note: This card exists so a marker can see the at-rest story end to end without a cloud console. It is NOT evidence of a live AWS account - the README fallback checkbox for 'no AWS account' stays ticked.
